Re: The Conundrum

After a recent query about “The Conundrum” :

I meet up with Gina MacLeod, who is an excellent singer, every year at Dougie MacLean’s “Perthshire Amber” Festival. She has some information about her illustrious piping relations on her website - link below - which mentions the origins of “The Conundrum”.

http://www.ginamacleod.co.uk/assets/img/title_simple.gif

The Conundrum, X:3

This is the way I play it, as DonaldK says above, with more snaps. When I started my first ceilidh band many years ago I was told not to use this tune for a Canadian Barndance as it would confuse the dancers. We took it as a challenge and with a strong, straight accompaniment it was in our repertoire throughout.

↳ Posted by bagpie on November 2nd, 2024.

Re: The Conundrum

Just to add, this is a 2/4 march rather than a 4/4 march. I had added inline fields to the ABCs to display the dots correctly but they’ve been removed. For dancing a Canadian barndance it would have two beats to the bar at around 85bpm.
